areas.evidence: Real native diagnostic → master plan → two small lessons → all four formats per lesson → confident wrong answer/committed correction → delayed unassisted review → completion. Coverage and queued review remain distinct.
areas.deduction: The model sometimes waits for an ordinary learner continuation after feedback; this remains a conversation, and long code-option labels can be dense.

areas.evidence: Native keyboard response controls accept seven scripted fixture answers across five formats; native modal focus/Tab/Escape/return and inert closed sidebar pass. Actual themes, 54 essential-text/eight syntax contrast observations, larger text and genuine 200% browser zoom are recorded.
areas.deduction: Setup/reveal used mixed input; no complete keyboard-only or WCAG conformance audit is claimed.

areas.evidence: Original home/sidebar/session/plan/graph retained. Mobile modal navigation, settings selection, per-lesson options/defaults and unfinished state/reload recovery verified.
areas.deduction: Some inherited navigation and Settings labels remain dense.

areas.evidence: Original real fonts/themes, readable prose measure, status/feedback hierarchy, native syntax/line-number/copy/expand panels, consistent controls and stable tool mounts. Real generated content viewed on desktop and phone.
areas.deduction: Inherited monospace Settings and code-heavy multiple-choice options still have room for refinement.

areas.evidence: Actual 1440/820/390/320 layouts, original modal sidebar/Settings, scoped 44px controls, no observed page-level overflow, local code scrolling, larger text/zoom and reduced motion. New actual real-session 1440/390 render passes.
areas.deduction: Browser emulation and geometry are not physical-device usability studies; 44px coverage is scoped.

areas.evidence: Real sign-in/plan/model generation, safe remote-return recovery, save/reload, Stop/Retry, plugin disable/re-enable, unchanged progress/account after restarts and enabled private native service. Real authoring error repaired without changing quiz mix.
areas.deduction: Cross-machine loopback returns may require manual recovery; deployment remains a private user-owned app.

ui_acceptance.boundary: Agent assessment using the repository-defined rubric and scoped observations. Not an Apple benchmark, independent user study, full WCAG audit, guarantee of every model response or human-mastery measurement.

real_native_acceptance.boundary: Real native provider, normal native/occurrence-bound APIs and a simulated learner in a separate synthetic topic. No direct accepted-record writes, real OAuth browser automation, credential-file inspection or human mastery claim.

actual_real_session_browser.boundary: Read-only browser visit to the real native synthetic-learning session. No OAuth, answer/model submission, account commands, credential/profile mount or account identity capture. Browser uses a fresh empty profile, a pipe for debugging, and blocks every other network origin.

privacy: Only a separate synthetic Python topic appears in public screenshots. No OAuth callback/code/state, credentials, email or account IDs are published.
